overview: 68 official Group 1 Prelims questions (2008–2024). Disaster management (15, mostly 2012 one-liners on NDMA/NIDM/Act dates), biodiversity (13) and health-environment (9) lead; climate initiatives, biotech, forest-wildlife law and pollution give 4–6 each; national environmental laws never asked directly. Since 2023 almost every item is a 2–5-statement set on a recent alliance, COP, species or Ramsar batch, where one sponsor, location, number or baseline is swapped.

possibility.what_they_ask: ecology terms (stenothermal, food chain as dynamic part), first state to mandate rooftop rainwater harvesting (Tamil Nadu)

possibility.evidence: 0 official Qs on the leaf; Indian Forest Act 1927 asked under forest law (2023)
possibility.what_they_ask: natural targets: year of each Act (WPA 1972, Water 1974, FCA 1980, Air 1981, EPA 1986, Biological Diversity 2002, NGT 2010), which body each creates, schedules of WPA

possibility.angle: International treaties and conventions (Ramsar, CMS, nitrogen)
possibility.what_they_ask: newest Ramsar sites, CMS COP venue/slogan, sponsors of an international scientific initiative

possibility.angle: Biodiversity: species, hotspots, IUCN status, global targets
possibility.what_they_ask: biodiversity hotspots in India, IUCN category and range of a species, new species discovered (who/where/name meaning), Hope Spots, seed vaults, 30×30 target, classic zoology/botany facts (halophytes, pearls from molluscs)

possibility.angle: Climate change: COPs, alliances, India's commitments
possibility.what_they_ask: COP venue and outcome (Copenhagen 2009, Sharm el-Sheikh 2022 loss and damage), founder/members of alliances (MAC, Global Shield), who implements an initiative in India
forest categories under IFA 1927, people's movements (Appiko), Project Cheetah facts, IBCA funding
metal behind a disease (Itai-itai = cadmium), dark-sky reserves, marine-litter projects and their agencies, first country with agricultural emission tax (New Zealand)

possibility.angle: National Action Plan on Climate Change
possibility.what_they_ask: number of missions (8) and names of individual missions

possibility.angle: Disaster management: Act, NDMA, NIDM, drought, cyclone-safe design
possibility.what_they_ask: year of DM Act (2005) and National Policy (2009), NDMA chair (PM), NIDM location and journal, drought-classification rainfall, cyclone-resistant roof, Project BHISHM nodal agency; related exams ask DM-cycle phases
first GE vaccine (Hepatitis B), who developed a 3D-printed tissue or xylitol process, India's first CAR-T therapy (NexCAR19)
principle of a nanogenerator (piezoelectric), which IIT developed a nano drug-carrier
what a Bt crop resists (insects), genotype vs phenotype

possibility.angle: Health and environment: diseases, vitamins, vectors
possibility.what_they_ask: organ affected by a disease (trachoma eyes), vitamin deficiency (B1 beriberi), discoverer (Koch – TB), larvivorous fish (Gambusia), disease–tissue matching

traps.trap: [E22/5] Baseline of the Paris target shifted
traps.spot: '1.5 °C … from the 2000s' or any baseline other than pre-industrial
traps.fix: Paris goal: well below 2 °C, pursuing 1.5 °C above pre-industrial levels

traps.trap: Extra member slipped into a membership list
traps.spot: a list of six-plus countries for a new alliance
traps.fix: One non-member falsifies the line; MAC had no USA or Canada at launch

traps.trap: Sponsor/implementer swapped to the best-known UN body
traps.spot: 'initiative of UNEP' or 'ASEAN initiative' for a niche project
traps.fix: GloLitter = IMO + FAO; INI = SCOPE + IGBP; NDC-TIA = German IKI consortium, India via NITI Aayog

traps.trap: IUCN status inflated and range relocated
traps.spot: a common butterfly/plant called 'Endangered' and placed in the Himalaya
traps.fix: Check status (Crimson Rose = Least Concern) and region (peninsular India, Sri Lanka)

traps.trap: Older genuine items as distractors for a 'new batch'
traps.spot: 'new sites added in <year>' with all options real
traps.fix: Remember the batch: 31 Jan 2024 – Karaivetti, Longwood Shola (TN); Magadi Kere, Ankasamudra, Aghanashini (Karnataka)

traps.trap: Numbers swapped between sexes or durations
traps.spot: '5 male, 3 female' or '₹150 crore for 2 years'
traps.fix: Kuno 2022 batch: 5 females, 3 males; IBCA: ₹150 crore over 5 years (2023-24 to 2027-28)

traps.trap: Previous edition's slogan/venue given for the current one
traps.spot: COP slogans, venues or themes in a numbered series
traps.fix: CMS COP13 Gandhinagar 2020 ('…welcome them home'); COP14 Samarkand 2024 ('Nature knows no borders')

traps.trap: Target redefined into a different sector
traps.fix: 30×30 = conserve 30% of land and ocean by 2030 (GBF Target 3)
India's extinct cheetah was the Asiatic subspecies (declared extinct 1952); Kuno animals are African

techniques.name: [E22/5] Sponsor-first check
techniques.how: For any alliance/project, first fix who launched it and where (COP number); then test membership and aims.
techniques.example: MAC: UAE + Indonesia (I true), COP27 (III true), non-binding (IV true), US/Canada listed (II false) → I, III and IV only [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#117]

techniques.name: Negative-stem with all-true possibility
techniques.how: In 'which is incorrect', mark each line; if none is false choose 'None of the above' – do not invent a trap.
techniques.example: Seed vaults: Svalbard, Chang La, NBPGR + DIHAR all true → None of the above [group1-prelims-2024-paper2#61]

techniques.name: Etymology decoding for new species
techniques.how: Split the species name into Sanskrit/Latin roots; the reason given in the statement must match the root.
techniques.example: varshaa (rain) + bhu (to appear) = emerges with the monsoon; 'changes colour' is not in the name → I correct, II incorrect [group1-prelims-2024-paper2#100]

techniques.name: Location triad for 'firsts'
techniques.how: For each 'first/headquarters' claim, check country, region and organisation separately.
techniques.example: Dark-sky: Mont-Mégantic is Canada (not Russia), IDA is US-based (not EU), India's first is Hanle, Ladakh (not HP) → only I true → None of the above [group1-prelims-2023-paper2#73]

techniques.name: Gradient ordering
techniques.how: For sequences of protection or severity, rank by legal restrictions: what is prohibited unless allowed vs allowed unless prohibited.
techniques.example: IFA 1927: Reserved (most restricted) > Protected > Village forest [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#99]

techniques.name: Organ-system matching
techniques.how: In disease matches, place each disease in its tissue first, then read codes.
techniques.example: Malaria → blood cells, filaria → lymph nodes, encephalitis → brain, leukaemia → bone marrow → AR, BS, CQ, DP [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#71]

techniques.name: Structural reasoning for disaster design
techniques.how: Ask what reduces the hazard force: slopes on all sides reduce wind uplift.
techniques.example: Cyclone roof: flat and gable ends catch wind → hip roof [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#56]

confusions.remember: Both COP27; L&D = UNFCCC fund for vulnerable countries; Global Shield = V20 + G7 risk finance and insurance (CDRFI)
GloLitter = sea-based litter from shipping and fishing
COP27 = loss and damage; COP15 Copenhagen (2009) was the 2010 question
Reserved: everything barred unless allowed; protected: allowed unless barred
India's lost cheetah was Asiatic (extinct 1952); Kuno got African cheetahs from Namibia and South Africa
Hotspots asked: Eastern Himalaya and Western Ghats (plus Indo-Burma, Sundaland)
Halo = salt (seashore); psammo = sand; xero = dry
Steno = narrow range; eury = wide range
Phenotype = observable traits; genotype = genetic make-up
Itai-itai = Cd bone pain; Minamata = Hg
DM Act 2005 created both; National Policy on DM 2009
30×30 protects land and ocean, not energy
Both forest protection by hugging trees; Appiko = southern counterpart

anchors: Disaster Management Act 2005; National Policy on DM 2009; NDMA chaired by PM
Paris goal – well below 2 °C, pursuing 1.5 °C above pre-industrial
COP27 – Sharm el-Sheikh 2022: Loss and Damage fund; Global Shield; MAC launched
Project Cheetah – 17 Sept 2022, Kuno NP; 8 Namibian (5 F, 3 M)
IBCA – 96 range countries; ₹150 crore, 5 years (2023-24 to 2027-28)
Ramsar batch 31 Jan 2024 – Karaivetti, Longwood Shola, Magadi Kere, Ankasamudra, Aghanashini
Hanle, Ladakh – India's first dark-sky reserve
Chang La, Ladakh – Indian seed vault (NBPGR + DIHAR)
Chronically drought-prone – rainfall threshold 750 mm (2016 manual, as keyed)
Hepatitis B – India's first genetically engineered vaccine
NexCAR19 – India's first indigenous CAR-T therapy
Gambusia – larvivorous fish in malaria control
Tamil Nadu – first state to make rooftop rainwater harvesting compulsory
checklist: Who launched it, at which COP/meeting? Fix that first.
Every list of members/sites: one wrong item sinks the line.
Check numbers twice – amount and period, male and female.
Temperature targets: baseline must be pre-industrial.
Species: check IUCN category, region and name meaning separately.
For 'incorrect' stems, allow 'None of the above' if all lines are true.
